description: Outbound HTTP for the local Yomitan API, and the dictionary hosts the dictionary engines download from (Yomitan, Hachidori, 10ten) — the last of which the dictionary settings window needs for imports. Deliberately not a general internet grant. AnkiConnect is not here: it is reached from Rust only (the anki_* commands and anki_connect_relay), at whatever address Settings → Anki names, because plugin-http would send the webview's Origin, which AnkiConnect refuses.
